newsitem.title: UK: Pillar buys 2 retail parks for 133.2 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Pillar buys 2 retail parks for 133.2 mln stg.

text.p: Pillar Property Investments Plc on Friday said it was acquiring two retail parks for 133.2 million stg.
It also announced a 1-for-7 rights issue of 20.21 million new shares at 205 pence per share.

The Kinnaird park in Edinburgh, was purchased for 81 million stg. It includes 254,981 square feet of retail space and 79,330 square feet of leisure space. Total current rent for the park is 3.9 million stg a year, representing an average rent of 11.66 stg per square foot.

The Fosse Park South park in Leicester, central England, was acquired for 52.2 million stg. It comprises 135,000 square feet of retail warehouse accommodation. Initial rental income is 2.8 million stg annually, equal to an average rent of 22.33 stg per square foot.

Following the acquisitions, retail assets will comprise 71 percent of Pillar's total investment portfolio, the company said in a statement. It now has 16 parks, with a total value of 355 million stg, covering more than 2.1 million square feet.
The company said the rights issue will fund in part the two latest acquisitions.
Kleinwort Benson Securities Ltd are the brokers.
Pillar also reported a 59 percent jump in pretax profits to 10.2 million stg for the year to March 31, 1997.
"I look forward to further strong progress being made from our investment portfolio and development in the current year," chairman Raymond Mould said in the statement.
